question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **'ways'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes different manners or methods in which exploitation in the marketplace can occur.
 
• Options like 'means', 'status', and 'paths' do not aptly capture the idea of variety in modes or methods of exploitation.
 
• 'Ways' fits perfectly as it conveys the different methods or manners in which a particular event (in this case, exploitation) can take place.

Therefore, the correct answer is ***'ways'***.

**The Passage is**__ Exploitation in the marketplace happens in various (1) __**ways**__. For example, sometimes traders indulge in (2) ________ trade practices such as when shopkeepers weigh less than what they should or when traders add charges that were not mentioned before, or when (3) _________ goods are sold. Markets do not work in a fair manner when producers are few and powerful whereas consumers purchase in small amounts and are (4) _________. This happens especially when large companies are producing these goods. These companies with huge wealth, power and reach can (5) ________ the market in various ways.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

__
 
• **Exploitation (शोषण)** - The action or fact of treating someone unfairly in order to benefit from their work.

 
 
• **Example: **The company was found guilty of worker exploitation due to poor working conditions and low wages.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Best way to solve the Cloze test:**

 
 
• Before you begin filling in the blanks, always make sure to read the entire passage with its blanks. This will help you to grasp the overall tone of the text, which in turn can assist you in eliminating incorrect options.
